connector.name: GMO Coin FX MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for GMO Coin FX trading, positions, executions, klines, and account balances.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image gmocoin-fx-mcp:1.0.1. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rikitonoto account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
